meta.title: FamHub: Kids Arrival Alerts & Safe Zones | Cross Tech Edu
meta.description: FamHub tells parents when their child reaches school or leaves home: safe zone alerts, live location your child chooses to share, one-tap check-ins and daily to-dos.

app.name: FamHub
app.description: Family app with safe zone arrival alerts, child-shared live location, one-tap check-ins and daily to-dos.

data.title: FamHub: know your kids got there safely.
data.lead: Know your child got there safely. Get an alert when they reach school or leave home, see their live location when they share it, and keep daily to-dos on track together.
data.sub: No ads and no third-party analytics. Accounts link only when both sides agree.

rate.label: Status
rate.note: FamHub (Vietnamese name: Kigo) is on the App Store. The Android build will be added when approved.

data.title: Two simple modes, one for parents and one for kids.
data.intro: Parents get updates, safe zones and a to-do list. A companion mode on your child's phone has big, friendly buttons to check in, share their location and see their tasks.

data.title: Peace of mind without the constant calls.
data.intro: FamHub is built around the moments parents actually wonder about: did they arrive, where are they now, and is the homework done?

items.title: Safe zone alerts
items.body: Get a notification when your child arrives at or leaves a safe zone, even when the app on their phone is closed.

items.title: Live location, shared by your child
items.body: Your child taps to share for the next 60 minutes. Ask with one tap and they get a friendly prompt. When sharing ends, the shared location is deleted.

items.title: One-tap check-ins
items.body: "Going to school", "Going to play", "I've arrived", "I'm home": their current location is sent along with each tap.

items.title: Daily to-dos
items.body: Assign tasks with a due date. Kids see a cheer when they finish one, and you get notified right away.

items.title: Notes for parents
items.body: Kids can send small requests. Mark a note as done so everyone stays in the loop.

items.title: Built for the whole family
items.body: Follow several children from one parent account, and link up to 3 parents or guardians with each child.

data.title: Set up in four steps.
data.intro: You can try FamHub right away without signing up, then link an email later to keep your data.

steps.title: Install on both phones
steps.body: Choose the parent mode on your phone and the companion mode on your child's.

steps.title: Link your accounts
steps.body: Enter the other person's 6-character code. They have to accept, so no one is linked without agreeing.

steps.title: Mark your safe zones
steps.body: Alerts need location set to "Always" on your child's phone. Using location in the background can reduce battery life.

steps.title: Get the updates
steps.body: Arrivals, departures, check-ins and finished tasks appear on your home screen as they happen.

data.title: Available on iPhone. Android pending review.
data.intro: FamHub is called Kigo in Vietnam. It is the same app, available in English, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, Indonesian and Portuguese.

items.title: For iPhone and iPad
items.body: Download FamHub (Vietnamese name: Kigo) from the App Store. Requires iOS 15 or later.

items.title: For Android
items.body: Not available yet. The download link will appear here when FamHub launches.

note.text: Your child's location is shared only with the parents and guardians linked to their account.
